sloka: ततस्तु प्रघसा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।कण्ठमस्या नृशंसायाः पीडयामः किमास्यते ।। ५.२२.३६।।।।
transliteration: tatastu praghasā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।kaṇṭhamasyā nṛśaṁsāyāḥ pīḍayāmaḥ kimāsyate ।। 5.22.36।।।।

translations.english: "O demonesses, all of you jointly dispose Janaki towards me. See that she submits to me at once.
